description: This is a C# source file for a web API backend, setting up an ASP.NET Core application with OpenAPI/Swagger documentation, CORS, forwarded headers, health check, and a validity check endpoint. It also defines related request and response classes.

classes.name: ValidityCheckRequest
classes.description: Request payload class for the validity check endpoint, requiring a non-empty string 'Value'.

classes.name: ValidityCheckResponse
classes.description: Response payload class indicating whether the input value is valid and an optional reason.

methods.name: BuildPublishedServerUrl
methods.description: Constructs the server URL based on environment variables, request headers, and forwarded headers to ensure correct external URL in API documentation.

methods.name: ConfigureOpenApiDocument
methods.description: Configures the OpenAPI document to set the server URL dynamically based on the incoming request.
